svg.text: Three updates account for most of the growth lift available this week.
You have growth momentum, but 3 landing pages are starting to slip.

The strongest next move is to refresh the pages that dropped from positions 4-8, then tighten two titles with strong impression volume. This keeps the overview focused on action instead of making the user scan ten different widgets.
High-value pages are still pulling new traffic.
Internal linking is improving deeper page discovery.
Title fixes are the fastest next lever to pull.
Rankings are stronger, but page two still matters.
One ranked queue, not ten competing widgets.
This is the center of the redesign: alerts, opportunities, and AI guidance collapse into one ranked work queue with impact and one clear next step per row.
Fix low-CTR winners on two high-impression queries
Refresh three landing pages slipping from positions 4-8
Strengthen internal links for twelve page-two opportunities

Organic traffic is stable enough to support a focused sprint. You do not need a redesign of every module; you need a tighter overview that makes the best actions obvious and compresses the noise into proof panels below.
Traffic is climbing steadily after content refreshes and title changes.
